name: ci-health
description: Audit CI bottlenecks, optimize existing pipelines, and review proposed changes for inefficiency before push.

interface.longDescription: Use CI Health to audit bottlenecks, establish a baseline, or verify results. Use CI Health Preflight to find added CI work in proposed changes before push. Use CI Health Optimize to design or implement targeted improvements to feedback time, staging readiness, or runner demand. Includes optional read-only GitHub Actions measurement helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use $ci-health to find avoidable CI work and feedback bottlenecks, and recommend improvements while preserving required checks.
